hotspots.title: Krakow Mass Shooting & Far-Right Suspect
hotspots.blurb: Thousands gathered in Kraków for a silent march led jointly by Poland's President and Prime Minister following the mass shooting that left six dead. The gunman, identified as holding far-right views, died in hospital, while top political figures honored responding officers amid heightened national security concerns.
hotspots.affect: The tragedy has generated profound national grief alongside intense contention over far-right radicalization and domestic security.

hotspots.title: House GOP Impeachment Push Against Pete Hegseth
hotspots.blurb: Republican Congressman Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over his handling of the war with Iran. President Trump and key allies like Marco Rubio and JD Vance have forcefully defended Hegseth, exposing a deep rift within the MAGA movement.
hotspots.affect: An unprecedented intra-party impeachment effort creates maximum friction and ideological confrontation over foreign war policy within the conservative base.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Pope Leo XIV's visit to Argentina has fueled intense political combat as media and opposition figures interpret his speeches on poverty and AI as direct rebukes of Javier Milei's austerity program. The Milei administration has actively denied any papal criticism while internal factional fighting erupts between Karina Milei, Victoria Villarruel, and Patricia Bullrich.
hotspots.affect: The clash of papal moral authority against libertarian shock-therapy economics commands massive media engagement and heightens government anxieties.

hotspots.title: Santiago Abascal & David Broncano TV Clash
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal's appearance on David Broncano's popular program 'La Revuelta' turned into an explosive exchange over Pedro Sánchez, Israel, and Hamas. Right-wing media celebrated Abascal's aggressive stance while opponents condemned his rhetoric, turning the broadcast into a major culture-war spectacle.
hotspots.affect: The fiery confrontation weaponized prime-time entertainment for intense culture-war score-settling and ideological polarization.

hotspots.title: Viktor Orbán's Brother Arrested in Human Smuggling Probe
hotspots.blurb: Áron Orbán, brother of former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, was detained in a police investigation targeting human trafficking networks. Viktor Orbán denounced the raids as a political 'dirty game,' while Peter Magyar's opposition Tisza party seized on the arrest to highlight government hypocrisy.
hotspots.affect: The arrest directly strikes at Fidesz's flagship anti-immigration platform, triggering intense public outrage and political recriminations.
